WITH all_teams_in_league AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        l.id as league_id,
        l.name as league_name,
        m.home_team_api_id as team_api_id
    FROM Match m
    JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id
    WHERE m.home_team_goal IS NOT NULL AND m.away_team_goal IS NOT NULL
    UNION
    SELECT DISTINCT
        l.id as league_id,
        l.name as league_name,
        m.away_team_api_id as team_api_id
    FROM Match m
    JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id
    WHERE m.home_team_goal IS NOT NULL AND m.away_team_goal IS NOT NULL
),
team_wins AS (
    SELECT 
        l.id as league_id,
        l.name as league_name,
        t.team_api_id,
        t.team_long_name as team_name,
        COUNT(*) as wins
    FROM Match m
    JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id
    JOIN Team t ON (
        CASE 
            WHEN m.home_team_goal > m.away_team_goal THEN m.home_team_api_id
            WHEN m.away_team_goal > m.home_team_goal THEN m.away_team_api_id
            ELSE NULL
        END
    ) = t.team_api_id
    WHERE m.home_team_goal IS NOT NULL AND m.away_team_goal IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY l.id, l.name, t.team_api_id, t.team_long_name
),
teams_with_wins AS (
    SELECT league_id, league_name, team_api_id, team_name, wins
    FROM team_wins
),
teams_with_zero_wins AS (
    SELECT 
        atl.league_id,
        atl.league_name,
        atl.team_api_id,
        t.team_long_name as team_name,
        0 as wins
    FROM all_teams_in_league atl
    JOIN Team t ON atl.team_api_id = t.team_api_id
    LEFT JOIN teams_with_wins tw ON atl.league_id = tw.league_id AND atl.team_api_id = tw.team_api_id
    WHERE tw.league_id IS NULL
),
all_team_wins AS (
    SELECT league_id, league_name, team_api_id, team_name, wins FROM teams_with_wins
    UNION ALL
    SELECT league_id, league_name, team_api_id, team_name, wins FROM teams_with_zero_wins
),
ranked_teams AS (
    SELECT 
        league_id,
        league_name,
        team_api_id,
        team_name,
        wins,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY league_id ORDER BY wins ASC, team_api_id ASC) as rn
    FROM all_team_wins
)
SELECT 
    league_name,
    team_name,
    wins
FROM ranked_teams
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY league_name
